lessons_used: Moving sign-in after pet adoption (+16.8% vs +12.0%) and adding cloud storage backup copy (+4.9% vs +0.5%) were helpful and exceeded predictions, while sign-in hints, progress trackers, and moving sign-in before launch showed no clear effect.

Dynamic waiting screen additions (progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), while static time estimates, checklists, audio selectors, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Photo quality tips were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), whereas adoption certificate redesigns severely hurt performance (-27.5%) and card layout changes showed no clear effect.
Desktop mascot audio redesign on the finish screen was helpful (+7.5% vs -3.0%), but finish screen control guides, notification prompts, owner badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
All welcome path selection changes (copy, layout, and direct selection cards) showed no clear effect, with predictions consistently over-estimating impact.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Sound Preview Component
candidates.change: Redesign the friend picker screen with interactive pet sound preview buttons and a playful layout so users hear sound effects while choosing their companion.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the main setup (63.8%) and long mean time (1017s); previous audio and sound quality additions produced significant positive lifts.

pick_friend.headline: Listen and Pick Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Tap each companion to hear their unique audio sounds and voice effects before adopting.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend with sound preview buttons preserves its primary job of letting the user choose a pet companion.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest dropoff, but screen redesigns here consistently hurt conversion severely.

candidates.title: Pet Voice Pitch Customizer Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new companion voice pitch customization screen before adoption confirmation, letting users test and set their pet audio tone.
candidates.why: Adoption takes a long average duration (1017s), and users engage strongly with pet audio customization features.

new_voice_customizer.headline: Choose Your Pet's Voice Pitch
new_voice_customizer.body: Select a cheerful or calm sound profile for your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: Adding a new screen inside onboarding to customize pet voice pitch is permitted under Rule 4 and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targeting adoption step dropoff, but adding an extra screen introduces extra onboarding friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Preparation Interactive Audio Activity
candidates.change: Add an interactive sound-and-visual background activity to the waiting screen where users tap ambient sound nodes while generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s); dynamic audio-visual waiting features previously boosted conversion (+9.3%).

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Awakening
waiting.body: Tap the ambient sound nodes while we synthesize your companion's desktop engine.

guard.reason: Adding ambient sound nodes to the waiting screen maintains the core function of showing that the pet is being generated.

candidates.score_note: Dynamic wait screen features help, though new interactive flows carry implementation overhead.

candidates.title: Move Account Creation After Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Reorder the sign_in screen to happen after pet generation waiting completes, right before launching to the desktop intro.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in, and moving sign-in later previously increased conversion.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by 8 support complaints and strong historic lift from sign-in reordering.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Recovery Assurance Headline
candidates.change: Update headline and messaging on sign_in to explicitly guarantee existing pets and customized data will restore seamlessly.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received last week regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Preserve & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Your companion data and past pets are safely bound to your account and will sync instantly upon sign in.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet never resets when switching devices.

guard.reason: Updating sign_in messaging to reassure existing account users preserves the core sign_in functionality without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change directly addressing 8 support emails; copy updates on sign-in previously yielded +4.9%.

candidates.title: Live Pet Audio Generation Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Display a real-time audio waveform animation and hint on the waiting screen showing companion voice generation status.
candidates.why: Waiting step dropoff is high (86.5% home, 201s median) and dynamic visual progress indicators were proven effective.

waiting.hint: Synthesizing companion voice waveforms and sound effects...

guard.reason: Adding a real-time waveform animation to the waiting screen communicates generation progress without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Solves long wait times using dynamic visual indicators which historically exceeded lift expectations.

candidates.title: Desktop App Taskbar Pinning Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint and badge component on the finish screen explaining where the pet app icon lives in the desktop system tray.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails (3 emails) reporting that pets do not show on desktop or users cannot re-open the app.

home_intro.hint: Your pet runs in your desktop system tray (near the clock). Click the tray icon anytime to bring your pet back!

guard.reason: Adding system tray usage guidance to home_intro is an allowed modification inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 3 support tickets regarding app visibility, though finish hints historically show modest effects.

candidates.title: Multi-Photo Audio Quality Incentive
candidates.change: Add a prominent incentive badge on upload_photos explaining that high-clarity photos unlock richer mascot vocal reactions.
candidates.why: Adoption dropoff is 63.8% and photo quality audio tips proved successful in earlier tests (+8.7%).

upload_photos.hint: Clear, well-lit photos unlock realistic voice reactions and sound effects for your pet!

guard.reason: Promising a 'Bonus Vocal Expression Unlocked' in onboarding copy violates Rule 3, which prohibits mentioning gifts, bonuses, or free extras.

candidates.title: Centered Desktop Pet Path Overview
candidates.change: Reorganize choose_path into a centered layout with a welcoming mascot audio preview component.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a mean time of 514s despite low median (8s), showing long-tail confusion on initial selection.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Choose a pre-made pet companion or craft a custom friend from your own photos.

candidates.title: Mascot Soundboard Finish Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a mascot soundboard preview where users test different pet voice buttons before launching to desktop.
candidates.why: Finish screen dropoff is 73.2% with 395s median time; desktop mascot audio welcome features generated +7.5% lift previously.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Mascot!
home_intro.body: Test your mascot's audio soundboard below, then click finish to release them onto your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro to include soundboard previews before launching to the desktop is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Mascot audio redesigns on the finish screen previously achieved a strong +7.5% lift.

lessons_next: Moving sign-in after pet adoption (+16.8% vs +12.0%) and adding cloud storage backup copy (+4.9% vs +0.5%) were helpful and exceeded predictions, while sign-in hints, progress trackers, safeguards, and other reorders showed no clear effect.

Dynamic waiting screen additions (live progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), while static estimates, checklists, audio selectors, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.

Photo quality sound tips were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), whereas adoption certificate redesigns severely hurt performance (-27.5%) and card layout or sound preview changes showed no clear effect.
Desktop mascot audio welcome redesign on the finish screen was helpful (+7.5% vs -3.0%), but control guides, prompts, soundboard redesigns, and incentives showed no clear effect.
All welcome path selection changes (copy, layout, and direct selection cards) showed no clear effect, with predictions consistently overestimating impact.
